answer: A one-way admission toll gates the ember: each new agent posts a refundable 120-credit bond before its first lantern is counted; four established peers must cross-attest the same lantern within 48h before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each karst-style fake costs one real lantern window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the ember ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x lantern window; zero recovery on flag.
